phase: Prototype Host-side recovery that power-cycles the root port when an attached SFC is stuck in enumeration; stage-1 physical trials on the first controller

prototype.sdkconfig_difference_from_original: APP_PROJECT_VER* and FNK0099_HOST_RECOVERY/RECOVERY_* only; USB timing settings unchanged

design.enable: CONFIG_FNK0099_HOST_RECOVERY (default n); all main.c changes are inside this option, existing log lines unchanged
design.detection: usb_host_lib_info().num_devices >= 1 while usb_host_device_addr_list_fill() reports no configured device and no NEW_DEV arrived, for STUCK_MS=2000
design.action: usb_host_lib_set_root_port_power(false), wait until the device object is freed (num_devices 0 or ALL_FREE, timeout 1000 ms), hold 100/500/2000 ms, usb_host_lib_set_root_port_power(true)
design.limits: 3 attempts per connection, 9 per boot; never acts with no device present or while a keyboard is open; port left off if the device is not freed
design.execution_context: usb_events task, usb_host_lib_handle_events with a 100 ms timeout

source_facts_checked: Enumeration cancel only closes the enumerator's handle; the device object is freed only when gone (components/usb/enum.c:849-880, usbh.c:1054-1061), so a failed device stays counted in num_devices.
usb_host_device_addr_list_fill lists only configured devices with a non-zero address (usbh.c:802-848).
Root-port power-off clears the DWC port power bit only (usb_host.c:728-738, hub.c:646-663, hcd_dwc.c:1202-1216); VBUS to the connector is not switched.

flash_handling.before_write: Board flash 0x0-0x5DFFF read back and matched the original 07e005a backup byte-for-byte
flash_handling.write: App image only at 0x10000, hash-verified (bootloader and partition table remain 07e005a)
flash_handling.restore_between_comparisons: Before each later image change (11:09 and 11:27) the backup range 0x0-0x5DFFF was written back and the full-range readback matched the original

controller_and_connection.controller: first physical SFC, firmware not rewritten (observed usages match public v1.0.0, SELECT=Tab)
controller_and_connection.cable: user-reported direct USB-C to USB-C, orientation unchanged but not established

trials.label: K0
trials.condition: UART-reset start with SFC attached (day-2 control)

trials.label: T2-1..T2-5
trials.condition: UART-reset start with SFC attached, 40 s each, no user action

identical_sequence_in_all_5.event: recovery attempt 1: port power off; device freed within about 10 ms (USB library flags=0x2)
port power on after 100 ms hold
attempt 2 (500 ms hold) failed at the same stage
attempt 3 (2000 ms hold) failed at the same stage

trials.label: T4
trials.condition: After T2-5 gave up: non-resetting UART attach, user physically unplugged and replugged the SFC, then pressed Right and B
trials.result: unplug freed the device (flags=0x2, recovery note unplugged); replug enumerated normally (DEVICE 1209:d004, keyboard start ESP_OK, recovery note normal, no action); Right 0x080 and B 0x001 pressed and released

trials.label: T0
trials.condition: UART-reset start with no SFC attached, 60 s
trials.result: no recovery action, no errors, free_heap constant

trials.label: T1
trials.condition: Same session as T0: user inserted the SFC after HOST_READY and pressed Right, B, A
trials.result: enumerated normally (recovery note normal, no action); Right 0x080, B 0x001, A 0x100 pressed and released; no errors

trials.label: T3-1..T3-3
trials.condition: Cold power-on: USB-UART unplugged at the Mac for 14.7-15.8 s with SFC attached, non-resetting attach after the port returned, Right and B about 20 s later
trials.evidence: DEVICE 1209:d004 at log 671 ms, keyboard start ESP_OK at 771 ms, recovery note normal (no action), Right and B received

interpretation: Power-cycling the root port works mechanically without switching VBUS: the disconnect is detected and the stuck device object is freed every time, and later physical unplug/replug, host-first insertion and the no-device case are unaffected. It does not recover the UART-reset start: once the first enumeration has failed, the SFC does not answer GET_DESCRIPTOR on any later bus reset within about 10 s. Cold power-on enumerated 3/3 on this image without any recovery action; see sfc-first-enumeration-timing-2026-11-18.json for the comparison that explains this.
final_state_after_this_record: Superseded by the timing record (board later carried rcv1-pp-d1000).
privacy: Selected build, flash-handling and diagnostic fields only. Raw UART and esptool logs, flash backups and their hashes, UART port, MAC, absolute local paths and device serials remain outside Git.
